author: The Wall Street Journal
description:
Elon Musk hailed the Cybertruck as Tesla’s “best product ever,” projecting annual production of 250,000 vehicles to reimagine the classic American pickup. Now, the electric-vehicle maker is winding down production to make way for the self-driving Cybercab. Hit by production delays, recalls, quality problems and political backlash, the Cybertruck saw just over 20,000 sales in 2025, a figure expected to drop further this year. 

WSJ’s Becky Peterson and Sean O’Kane explain what went wrong with Musk’s polarizing pickup.
